uploads.changelog:
siikk-Damage Numbers 1.3 – more looks and motion patterns

- Style presets with one click: siikk (default), Classic, Minimal, Epic, Comic, Retro/Pixel, Elegant and Explosive – every value can still be changed afterwards.
- 10 fonts: Poppins plus Bangers, Russo One, Cinzel, Oswald, Press Start 2P (all SIL OFL) and the WoW fonts Friz Quadrata, Arial Narrow, Skurri, Morpheus. Font size, crit size, outline (none/thin/thick/extra thick) and shadow.
- 7 motion patterns: Rise, Arc/Fountain, Fan, Stack/List, Sideways, Explosion, Fall – plus crit animations Pop, Shake, Pulse or None, speed and spread sliders.
- Colors: per school of magic, one custom color, class color or rainbow; custom crit and healing colors (color picker).
- Number format 12345 / 12,345 / 12.3k, optional spell icon next to the number, optional merging of hits ("x3"), limit for numbers on screen.
- New settings window with tabs, "Reset to defaults" button, /sz stil <name> and /sz reset. Your existing settings are kept – nothing changes unless you want it to.
- Fixed: the first /sz after login did not open the settings window.
